title: Top 10 Essential Verbs in English for Absolute Beginners (A0–A1 / A2)
dek: Master the first 10 high-frequency verbs in English (be, have, think, know, like, want/would like, go/be going to, can, eat, drink). Conjugation tables are consultable on COSYtools.

blocks.text: Welcome to Part 1 of our 2-part core verb series for A0–A1 and A2 English learners! This article introduces the first 10 essential verbs for daily communication with simple sentences and useful phrases. (Explore [Part 2](top-10-verbs-part-2-en.html) for the next 10 verbs). Complete conjugation tables for all verbs are consultable on [COSYtools](https://cosylanguages.github.io/COSYtools/).

items:
**1. To Be (am / is / are):** Identity, states, age, and location.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I am a student', 'He is at home', 'They are ready', 'I am 25 years old'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'be on time', 'be quiet', 'be right'.

**2. To Have (have / has):** Possession, relationships, and states.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I have a car', 'She has a sister', 'I have a headache'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'have breakfast', 'have a shower', 'have a good day'.

**3. To Think:** Opinions and thoughts.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I think so', 'What do you think?', 'I think it is good'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'think twice', 'think about', 'think of'.

**4. To Know:** Facts, familiarity, and skills.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I know the answer', 'Do you know him?', 'I know how to drive'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'let me know', 'as far as I know', 'you know'.

**5. To Like:** Preferences and taste.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I like coffee', 'She likes reading', 'Do you like sports?'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'like very much', 'would like', 'look like'.

**6. To Want / Would Like:** Desires and polite requests.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I want water', 'I would like tea, please', 'Where do you want to go?'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'want to learn', 'would like to order', 'if you want'.

**7. To Go / Be Going To:** Movement and future intentions.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I go to work', 'She goes home', 'We are going to eat'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'go home', 'go shopping', 'go on foot', 'be going to eat'.

**8. To Can (Modal):** Ability and permission.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I can speak English', 'Can you help me?', 'You can sit here'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'can I have...', 'as fast as I can', 'can do'.

**9. To Eat:** Food and meals.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I eat fruit', 'What do you want to eat?', 'Let's eat out'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'eat healthy', 'eat out', 'something to eat'.

**10. To Drink:** Beverages and hydration.
  • *Usage & Frames:* 'I drink water', 'Would you like to drink?', 'He drinks coffee'.
  • *Useful Phrases:* 'drink water', 'a hot drink', 'something to drink'.

blocks.text: Grammar & Structure for A0–A1 / A2 Learners

• **Simple Sentence Structures:** Focus on Subject + Verb + Object.
• **Auxiliaries & Modals:** Use 'can', 'must', and 'be going to' for simple daily intentions.
• **Conjugations:** Check full present, past, and future tense tables on [COSYtools](https://cosylanguages.github.io/COSYtools/).
